dashboards_data.name: Veeam Data Platform Monitoring
dashboards_data.description: Aggregated information about jobs run on Veeam Backup & Replication servers.

data.phrase:
dataset in (veeam_*) 
| filter _vendor="Veeam"
| alter 
    _instanceId=arrayindex(regextract(_raw_log, "instanceId\=(\d+)\s"), 0)
| filter _instanceId in ("151","190","194","198","200","250","251","290","390","490","590","592","652","790","36022","36026","40290","44102")
| alter 
_jobResultCode=arrayindex(if(
    _instanceId in ("790","652"), regextract(_raw_log, "(?:JobResult|param3)\=\"(\d+)\""), 
    _instanceId in ("36022","36026","290","40290","350","351","360","361","41001","198"), regextract(_raw_log, "Result\=\"(\d+)\""), 
    _instanceId in ("150","151","451","450","250","251"), regextract(_raw_log, "Status\=\"(\d+)\""), 
    _instanceId in ("44102"), regextract(_raw_log, "Status\=\"(\w+)\""), 
    regextract(_raw_log, "JobResult\=\"(\d+)\"")), 0),
_host=arrayindex(regextract(_raw_log , "\s(\S+)\s(?:Veeam_MP|Veeam_Backup|Veeam_Security)"), 0)
| alter _jobResultCode=if(_instanceId in ("150","151","451","450","250","251") and _jobResultCode = "3", "1", _instanceId in ("150","151","451","450","250","251") and _jobResultCode = "5", "3", _jobResultCode)
| alter _jobResultCode=if(_instanceId = "36024", "0", _jobResultCode = "Success", "0", _jobResultCode = "Warning", "1", _jobResultCode = "Failed", "2", _jobResultCode)
| filter _host in ($hosts)
| comp 
    count(_instanceId) as _total
| fields _total






| view graph type = single subtype = standard yaxis = _total

data.phrase:
dataset in (veeam_*) 
| filter _vendor="Veeam"
| alter 
    _instanceId=arrayindex(regextract(_raw_log, "instanceId\=(\d+)\s"), 0)
| filter _instanceId in ("151","190","194","198","200","250","251","290","390","490","590","592","652","790","36022","36026","40290","44102")
| alter 
_jobResultCode=arrayindex(if(
    _instanceId in ("790","652"), regextract(_raw_log, "(?:JobResult|param3)\=\"(\d+)\""), 
    _instanceId in ("36022","36026","290","40290","350","351","360","361","41001","198"), regextract(_raw_log, "Result\=\"(\d+)\""), 
    _instanceId in ("150","151","451","450","250","251"), regextract(_raw_log, "Status\=\"(\d+)\""), 
    _instanceId in ("44102"), regextract(_raw_log, "Status\=\"(\w+)\""), 
    regextract(_raw_log, "JobResult\=\"(\d+)\"")), 0),
_host=arrayindex(regextract(_raw_log , "\s(\S+)\s(?:Veeam_MP|Veeam_Backup|Veeam_Security)"), 0)
| alter _jobResultCode=if(_instanceId in ("150","151","451","450","250","251") and _jobResultCode = "3", "1", _instanceId in ("150","151","451","450","250","251") and _jobResultCode = "5", "3", _jobResultCode)
| alter _jobResultCode=if(_instanceId = "36024", "0", _jobResultCode = "Success", "0", _jobResultCode = "Warning", "1", _jobResultCode = "Failed", "2", _jobResultCode)
| filter _host in ($hosts)
| comp 
    count(if(_jobResultCode = "1", 1)) as _failed
| fields _failed


| view graph type = single subtype = standard yaxis = _failed

data.phrase:
dataset in (veeam_*) 
| filter _vendor="Veeam"
| alter 
    _instanceId=arrayindex(regextract(_raw_log, "instanceId\=(\d+)\s"), 0)
| filter _instanceId in ("151","190","194","198","200","250","251","290","390","490","590","592","652","790","36022","36026","40290","44102")
| alter 
_jobResultCode=arrayindex(if(
    _instanceId in ("790","652"), regextract(_raw_log, "(?:JobResult|param3)\=\"(\d+)\""), 
    _instanceId in ("36022","36026","290","40290","350","351","360","361","41001","198"), regextract(_raw_log, "Result\=\"(\d+)\""), 
    _instanceId in ("150","151","451","450","250","251"), regextract(_raw_log, "Status\=\"(\d+)\""), 
    _instanceId in ("44102"), regextract(_raw_log, "Status\=\"(\w+)\""), 
    regextract(_raw_log, "JobResult\=\"(\d+)\"")), 0),
_host=arrayindex(regextract(_raw_log , "\s(\S+)\s(?:Veeam_MP|Veeam_Backup|Veeam_Security)"), 0)
| alter _jobResultCode=if(_instanceId in ("150","151","451","450","250","251") and _jobResultCode = "3", "1", _instanceId in ("150","151","451","450","250","251") and _jobResultCode = "5", "3", _jobResultCode)
| alter _jobResultCode=if(_instanceId = "36024", "0", _jobResultCode = "Success", "0", _jobResultCode = "Warning", "1", _jobResultCode = "Failed", "2", _jobResultCode)
| filter _host in ($hosts)
| comp 
    count(if(_jobResultCode = "2", 1)) as _failed
| fields _failed






| view graph type = single subtype = standard yaxis = _failed

data.phrase:
dataset in (veeam_*) 
| filter _vendor="Veeam"
| alter 
    _instanceId=arrayindex(regextract(_raw_log, "instanceId\=(\d+)\s"), 0)
| filter _instanceId in ("190","790","194","490","451","36022","36026")
| alter 
    _time= parse_timestamp("%FT%H:%M:%E6S%Ez", arrayindex(regextract(_raw_log, "<\d+>1\s+(\S+)\s"), 0))
| alter 
_jobResultCode=arrayindex(if(
    _instanceId in ("790","652"), regextract(_raw_log, "(?:JobResult|param3)\=\"(\d+)\""),
    _instanceId in ("36022","36026"), regextract(_raw_log, "(?:JobResult|param3)\=\"(\d+)\""), 
    _instanceId in ("451"), regextract(_raw_log, "Status\=\"(\d+)\""), 
    regextract(_raw_log, "JobResult\=\"(\d+)\"")), 0),
_day=date_floor(_time ,"d"),
_host=arrayindex(regextract(_raw_log , "\s(\S+)\s(?:Veeam_MP|Veeam_Backup|Veeam_Security)"), 0)
| alter _jobResultCode=if(_instanceId in ("451") and _jobResultCode = "3", "1", _instanceId in ("451") and _jobResultCode = "5", "3", _jobResultCode)
| filter _host in ($hosts)
| comp 
    count(if(_jobResultCode = "0", 1)) as Success, 
    count(if(_jobResultCode = "1", 1)) as Warning,
    count(if(_jobResultCode = "2", 1)) as Failed,  
    count(if(_jobResultCode = "3", 1)) as Working by _day
| fields Success, Warning, Failed, Working, _day
| sort asc _day



| view graph type = area subtype = standard show_percentage = `false` xaxis = _day yaxis = Success,Warning,Failed,Working seriescolor("Success","#00D15F") seriescolor("Working","#0084D1") seriescolor("Warning","#FF8F2E") seriescolor("Failed","#D10000")

data.phrase:
dataset in (veeam_*) 
| filter _vendor="Veeam"
| alter 
    _instanceId=arrayindex(regextract(_raw_log, "instanceId\=(\d+)\s"), 0)
| filter _instanceId in ("390")
| alter 
    _time= parse_timestamp("%FT%H:%M:%E6S%Ez", arrayindex(regextract(_raw_log, "<\d+>1\s+(\S+)\s"), 0))
| alter 
_jobResultCode=arrayindex(regextract(_raw_log, "JobResult\=\"(\d+)\""), 0),
_day=date_floor(_time ,"d"),
_host=arrayindex(regextract(_raw_log , "\s(\S+)\s(?:Veeam_MP|Veeam_Backup|Veeam_Security)"), 0)
| filter _host in ($hosts)
| comp 
    count(if(_jobResultCode = "0", 1)) as Success, 
    count(if(_jobResultCode = "1", 1)) as Warning,
    count(if(_jobResultCode = "2", 1)) as Failed,  
    count(if(_jobResultCode = "3", 1)) as Working by _day
| fields Success, Warning, Failed, Working, _day
| sort asc _day





| view graph type = area subtype = standard show_percentage = `false` xaxis = _day yaxis = Success,Warning,Failed,Working seriescolor("Success","#00D15F") seriescolor("Working","#0084D1") seriescolor("Warning","#FF8F2E") seriescolor("Failed","#D10000")

data.phrase:
dataset in (veeam_*) 
| filter _vendor="Veeam"
| alter 
    _instanceId=arrayindex(regextract(_raw_log, "instanceId\=(\d+)\s"), 0)
| filter _instanceId in ("490")
| alter 
    _jobResultCode=arrayindex(regextract(_raw_log, "JobResult\=\"(\d+)\""), 0),
    _host=arrayindex(regextract(_raw_log , "\s(\S+)\s(?:Veeam_MP|Veeam_Backup|Veeam_Security)"), 0)
| filter _host in ($hosts)
| alter _jobResult=if(
    _jobResultCode = "0", "Success",
    _jobResultCode = "1", "Warning",
    _jobResultCode = "2", "Failed",
    _jobResultCode = "3", "Working")
| comp
    count(_instanceId) as _jobsByResult by _jobResult 







| view graph type = pie subtype = full xaxis = _jobResult yaxis = _jobsByResult seriestitle("_jobsByResult","Backup Copy Jobs") valuecolor("Success","#00D15F") valuecolor("Working","#0084D1") valuecolor("Warning","#FF8F2E") valuecolor("Failed","#D10000")

| filter _vendor="Veeam"

    _instanceId=arrayindex(regextract(_raw_log, "instanceId\=(\d+)\s"), 0)

    _jobResultCode=arrayindex(regextract(_raw_log, "JobResult\=\"(\d+)\""), 0),

data.phrase:
dataset in (veeam_*) 
| filter _vendor="Veeam"
| alter 
    _instanceId=arrayindex(regextract(_raw_log, "instanceId\=(\d+)\s"), 0)
| filter _instanceId in ("610")
| alter 
    _jobResultCode=arrayindex(regextract(_raw_log, "JobResult\=\"(\d+)\""), 0),
    _host=arrayindex(regextract(_raw_log , "\s(\S+)\s(?:Veeam_MP|Veeam_Backup|Veeam_Security)"), 0)
| filter  _host in ($hosts)
| alter _jobResult=if(
    _jobResultCode = "0", "Success",
    _jobResultCode = "1", "Warning",
    _jobResultCode = "2", "Failed",
    _jobResultCode = "3", "Working")
| comp
    count(_instanceId) as _jobsByResult by _jobResult 


| view graph type = pie subtype = full xaxis = _jobResult yaxis = _jobsByResult seriestitle("_jobsByResult","VM Quick Migration Jobs") valuecolor("Success","#00D15F") valuecolor("Working","#0084D1") valuecolor("Warning","#FF8F2E") valuecolor("Failed","#D10000")

dataset in (veeam_*) 
| filter _vendor="Veeam"
| alter 
    _instanceId=arrayindex(regextract(_raw_log, "instanceId\=(\d+)\s"), 0)
| filter _instanceId in ("36022")
| alter 
    _jobResultCode=arrayindex(regextract(_raw_log, "Result\=\"(\d+)\""), 0),
    _host=arrayindex(regextract(_raw_log , "\s(\S+)\s(?:Veeam_MP|Veeam_Backup|Veeam_Security)"), 0)
| filter  _host in ($hosts)
| alter _jobResult=if(
    _jobResultCode = "0", "Success",

| comp
    count(_instanceId) as _jobsByResult by _jobResult

data.phrase:
dataset in (veeam_*) 
| filter _vendor="Veeam"
| alter 
    _instanceId=arrayindex(regextract(_raw_log, "instanceId\=(\d+)\s"), 0)
| filter _instanceId in ("190")
| alter 
    _jobResultCode=arrayindex(regextract(_raw_log, "JobResult\=\"(\d+)\""), 0),
    _host=arrayindex(regextract(_raw_log , "\s(\S+)\s(?:Veeam_MP|Veeam_Backup|Veeam_Security)"), 0), 
    _jobType=arrayindex(regextract(_raw_log, "JobType\=\"(\d+)\""), 0)
| filter  _host in ($hosts) and _jobType="78"
| alter _jobResult=if(
    _jobResultCode = "0", "Success",
    _jobResultCode = "1", "Warning",
    _jobResultCode = "2", "Failed",
    _jobResultCode = "3", "Working")
| comp
    count(_instanceId) as _jobsByResult by _jobResult 

| view graph type = pie subtype = full xaxis = _jobResult yaxis = _jobsByResult seriestitle("_jobsByResult","Backup Jobs for Entra ID") valuecolor("Success","#00D15F") valuecolor("Working","#0084D1") valuecolor("Warning","#FF8F2E") valuecolor("Failed","#D10000")

data.phrase:
dataset in (veeam_*) 
| filter _vendor="Veeam"
| alter 
    _instanceId=arrayindex(regextract(_raw_log, "instanceId\=(\d+)\s"), 0)
| filter _instanceId in ("190")
| alter 
    _jobResultCode=arrayindex(regextract(_raw_log, "JobResult\=\"(\d+)\""), 0),
    _host=arrayindex(regextract(_raw_log , "\s(\S+)\s(?:Veeam_MP|Veeam_Backup|Veeam_Security)"), 0), 
    _jobType=arrayindex(regextract(_raw_log, "JobType\=\"(\d+)\""), 0),
    _sourceType=arrayindex(regextract(_raw_log, "SourceType=\"([^\"]*)\""), 0)
| filter  _host in ($hosts) and _jobType="13000" and _sourceType = "8"
| alter _jobResult=if(
    _jobResultCode = "0", "Success",
    _jobResultCode = "1", "Warning",
    _jobResultCode = "2", "Failed",
    _jobResultCode = "3", "Working")
| comp
    count(_instanceId) as _jobsByResult by _jobResult 



| view graph type = pie subtype = full xaxis = _jobResult yaxis = _jobsByResult seriestitle("_jobsByResult","Log Backup Jobs for Entra ID") valuecolor("Success","#00D15F") valuecolor("Working","#0084D1") valuecolor("Warning","#FF8F2E") valuecolor("Failed","#D10000")

args: Log Backup Jobs for Entra ID
func.name: seriestitle

dataset in (veeam_*) 
| filter _vendor="Veeam"
| alter 
    _instanceId=arrayindex(regextract(_raw_log, "instanceId\=(\d+)\s"), 0)
| filter _instanceId in ("190")
| alter 
    _jobResultCode=arrayindex(regextract(_raw_log, "JobResult\=\"(\d+)\""), 0),
    _host=arrayindex(regextract(_raw_log , "\s(\S+)\s(?:Veeam_MP|Veeam_Backup|Veeam_Security)"), 0),
    _jobTypeCode=if(
        _instanceId in ("290","40290"), "290", arrayindex(if(
            _instanceId in ("790","652"), regextract(_raw_log, "(?:JobType|param4)\=\"(\d+)\""), 
            "1"="1", regextract(_raw_log, "JobType\=\"(\d+)\"")), 0))
| filter _jobTypeCode = "1" AND _host in ($hosts)
| alter _jobResult=if(
    _jobResultCode = "0", "Success",
    _jobResultCode = "1", "Warning",
    _jobResultCode = "2", "Failed",
    _jobResultCode = "3", "Working")
| comp
    count(_instanceId) as _jobsByResult by _jobResult

data.phrase:
dataset in (veeam_*) 
| filter _vendor="Veeam"
| alter 
    _instanceId=arrayindex(regextract(_raw_log, "instanceId\=(\d+)\s"), 0)
| filter _instanceId in ("190")
| alter 
    _jobResultCode=arrayindex(regextract(_raw_log, "JobResult\=\"(\d+)\""), 0),
    _host=arrayindex(regextract(_raw_log , "\s(\S+)\s(?:Veeam_MP|Veeam_Backup|Veeam_Security)"), 0),
    _jobType=arrayindex(regextract(_raw_log, "JobType\=\"(\d+)\""), 0),
    _sourceType=arrayindex(regextract(_raw_log, "SourceType=\"([^\"]*)\""), 0)
| filter _host in ($hosts) and _jobType="13000" and _sourceType = "3"
| alter _jobResult=if(
    _jobResultCode = "0", "Success",
    _jobResultCode = "1", "Warning",
    _jobResultCode = "2", "Failed",
    _jobResultCode = "3", "Working")
| comp
    count(_instanceId) as _jobsByResult by _jobResult 








| view graph type = pie subtype = full xaxis = _jobResult yaxis = _jobsByResult seriestitle("_jobsByResult","File Backup Jobs") valuecolor("Success","#00D15F") valuecolor("Working","#0084D1") valuecolor("Warning","#FF8F2E") valuecolor("Failed","#D10000")

data.phrase:
dataset in (veeam_*) 
| filter _vendor="Veeam"
| alter 
    _instanceId=arrayindex(regextract(_raw_log, "instanceId\=(\d+)\s"), 0)
| filter _instanceId in ("194")
| alter 
    _jobResultCode=arrayindex(regextract(_raw_log, "JobResult\=\"(\d+)\""), 0),
    _host=arrayindex(regextract(_raw_log , "\s(\S+)\s(?:Veeam_MP|Veeam_Backup|Veeam_Security)"), 0)
| filter _host in ($hosts)
| alter _jobResult=if(
    _jobResultCode = "0", "Success",
    _jobResultCode = "1", "Warning",
    _jobResultCode = "2", "Failed",
    _jobResultCode = "3", "Working")
| comp
    count(_instanceId) as _jobsByResult by _jobResult 







| view graph type = pie subtype = full xaxis = _jobResult yaxis = _jobsByResult seriestitle("_jobsByResult","Tape Jobs") valuecolor("Success","#00D15F") valuecolor("Working","#0084D1") valuecolor("Warning","#FF8F2E") valuecolor("Failed","#D10000")

dataset in (veeam_*) 
| filter _vendor="Veeam"
| alter 
    _instanceId=arrayindex(regextract(_raw_log, "instanceId\=(\d+)\s"), 0)
| filter _instanceId in ("151","190","194","198","200","250","251","290","390","490","590","592","652","790","36022","36026","40290","44102")
| alter 
    _time= parse_timestamp("%FT%H:%M:%E6S%Ez", arrayindex(regextract(_raw_log, "<\d+>1\s+(\S+)\s"), 0)),
    _jobResultCode=arrayindex(if(
        _instanceId in ("790","652"), regextract(_raw_log, "(?:JobResult|param3)\=\"(\d+)\""), 
        _instanceId in ("36022","36026","290","40290","198","350","351","360","361","41001"), regextract(_raw_log, "Result\=\"(\d+)\""), 
        _instanceId in ("150","151","451","450","250","251"), regextract(_raw_log, "Status\=\"(\d+)\""), 
        _instanceId in ("44102"), regextract(_raw_log, "Status\=\"(\w+)\""), 
        regextract(_raw_log, "JobResult\=\"(\d+)\"")), 0),
    _jobTypeCode=if(
        _instanceId in ("290","40290","250","251"), "290", _instanceId = "41001", "13004", _instanceId = "36024", "12100", _instanceId = "44102", "44102", _instanceId in ("198"), "26", arrayindex(if(
            _instanceId in ("790","652"), regextract(_raw_log, "(?:JobType|param4)\=\"(\d+)\""), 
            "1"="1", regextract(_raw_log, "JobType\=\"(\d+)\"")), 0)),
    _host=regextract(_raw_log , "\s(\S+)\s(?:Veeam_MP|Veeam_Backup|Veeam_Security)"),
    _description=arrayindex(regextract(_raw_log, "\bDescription\=\"([^\"]*)(?:\"|$)"),0)
| alter _jobResultCode=if(_instanceId in ("150","151","451","450","250","251") and _jobResultCode = "3", "1", _instanceId in ("150","151","451","450","250","251") and _jobResultCode = "5", "3", _jobResultCode)
| alter _jobResultCode=if(_instanceId = "36024", "0", _jobResultCode = "Success", "0", _jobResultCode = "Warning", "1", _jobResultCode = "Failed", "2", _jobResultCode)

widgets_data.title: Finished Jobs by Type
widgets_data.description: Daily statistics on finished jobs by type.

data.phrase:
dataset in (veeam_*) 
| filter _vendor="Veeam"
| alter 
    _instanceId=arrayindex(regextract(_raw_log, "instanceId\=(\d+)\s"), 0)
| filter _instanceId in ("151","190","194","198","200","290","390","451","490","590","592","652","790","36022","36026","40290")
| alter 
    _time= parse_timestamp("%FT%H:%M:%E6S%Ez", arrayindex(regextract(_raw_log, "<\d+>1\s+(\S+)\s"), 0))
| alter 
    _jobTypeCode=if(
        _instanceId in ("290","40290"), "290", _instanceId = "198", "26", _instanceId = "200", "501", _instanceId = "590", "590", _instanceId = "592", "592", arrayindex(if(
            _instanceId in ("790","652"), regextract(_raw_log, "(?:JobType|param4)\=\"(\d+)\""), 
            "1"="1", regextract(_raw_log, "JobType\=\"(\d+)\"")), 0)),
    _day=date_floor(_time ,"d"),
    _host=arrayindex(regextract(_raw_log , "\s(\S+)\s(?:Veeam_MP|Veeam_Backup|Veeam_Security)"), 0)
| filter _host in ($hosts)
| comp 
        count(if(_jobTypeCode in ("1","50"), 1)) as _replicationJob,
        count(if(_jobTypeCode = "3", 1)) as _sureBackupJob,
        count(if(_jobTypeCode in ("0","14000"), 1)) as _backupJob,
        count(if(_jobTypeCode = "8", 1)) as _quickMigration,
        count(if(_jobTypeCode = "22", 1)) as _rescanJob,
        count(if(_jobTypeCode = "24", 1)) as _fileToTapeJob,
        count(if(_jobTypeCode = "28", 1)) as _backupToTapeJob,
        count(if(_jobTypeCode = "26", 1)) as _tapeVerificationJob,
        count(if(_jobTypeCode = "501", 1)) as _tapeCopyJob,
        count(if(_jobTypeCode = "52", 1)) as _msSQLLogBackupJob,
        count(if(_jobTypeCode = "54", 1)) as _oracleLogBackupJob,
        count(if(_jobTypeCode = "60", 1)) as _HPEStoreOnceReplicationJob,
        count(if(_jobTypeCode in ("2","51","63","65","70"), 1)) as _backupCopyJob,
        count(if(_jobTypeCode = "590", 1)) as _fileCopyJob,
        count(if(_jobTypeCode = "592", 1)) as _vmCopyJob,
        count(if(_jobTypeCode = "74", 1)) as _postgreSQLLogBackupJob,
        count(if(_jobTypeCode = "100", 1)) as _configurationBackupJob,
        count(if(_jobTypeCode = "104", 1)) as _configurationDatabaseMaintenanceJob,
        count(if(_jobTypeCode = "202", 1)) as _failoverPlan,
        count(if(_jobTypeCode = "290", 1)) as _restoreJob,
        count(if(_jobTypeCode = "203", 1)) as _undoFailoverPlan,
        count(if(_jobTypeCode = "316", 1)) as _cdpPolicy,
        count(if(_jobTypeCode in ("4000","12000","12003"), 1)) as _agentBackupJobBS,
        count(if(_jobTypeCode = "12002", 1)) as _agentBackupJobBP,
        count(if(_jobTypeCode = "12008", 1)) as _agentActiveFullBP,
        count(if(_jobTypeCode = "12100", 1)) as _appBackupPolicy,
        count(if(_jobTypeCode = "12101", 1)) as _appLogBackupPolicy,
        count(if(_jobTypeCode = "13000", 1)) as _fileBackupJob,
        count(if(_jobTypeCode = "13003", 1)) as _fileBackupCopyJob,
        count(if(_jobTypeCode = "15000", 1)) as _storageSnapshotSnapshotOnlyJob,
        count(if(_jobTypeCode = "15001", 1)) as _storageSnapshotBackupJob,
        count(if(_jobTypeCode = "15002", 1)) as _storageSnapshotCopyJob,
        count(if(_jobTypeCode = "15004", 1)) as _storageSnapshotRestoreSession,
        count(if(_jobTypeCode = "18000", 1)) as _archiveTierBackupJob,
        count(if(_jobTypeCode = "18001", 1)) as _archiveTierRestoreSession,
        count(if(_jobTypeCode = "18002", 1)) as _archiveDownloadSession,
        count(if(_jobTypeCode = "18003", 1)) as _archiveTierSynchronizationJob,
        count(if(_jobTypeCode = "18004", 1)) as _archiveTierBackupCopyJob,
        count(if(_jobTypeCode = "18005", 1)) as _archiveTierArchivingJob,
        count(if(_jobTypeCode = "18006", 1)) as _publishDiskSession,
        count(if(_jobTypeCode = "18008", 1)) as _objectStorageRepositorySynchronizationJob,
        count(if(_jobTypeCode = "24002", 1)) as _guestOSFileRestoreSession,
        count(if(_jobTypeCode in ("33000", "33001"), 1)) as _sureBackupScanOnly,
        count(if(_jobTypeCode = null OR _jobTypeCode not in ("0","1","2","3","8","22","24","26","28","50","51","52","54","60","63","65","70","74","100","104","202","203","290","316","501","590","592","4000","12000","12002","12003","12008","12100","12101","13000","13003","14000","15000","15001","15002","15004","18000","18001","18002","18003","18004","18005","18006","18008","24002","33000","33001"), 1)) as _otherJobType
            by _day
| sort asc _day

data.phrase:
dataset in (veeam_*) 
| filter _vendor="Veeam"
| alter 
    _instanceId=arrayindex(regextract(_raw_log, "instanceId\=(\d+)\s"), 0), 
    _vmName = arrayindex(regextract(_raw_log, "VmName=\"([^\"]*)\""), 0),
    _host=arrayindex(regextract(_raw_log , "\s(\S+)\s(?:Veeam_MP|Veeam_Backup|Veeam_Security)"), 0),
    _jobResultCode = regextract(_raw_log, "Status\=\"(\d+)\"")
| filter _instanceId in ("150", "450") 
| filter _jobResultCode in ("2", "3") 
| filter _host in ($hosts)
| alter _jobResult = if(
    _jobResultCode = "3", "Warning",
    _jobResultCode = "2", "Failed",
    "Other"  
    )
| comp 
    count(if(_jobResult = "Warning", _instanceId, null)) as Warning, 
    count(if(_jobResult = "Failed", _instanceId, null)) as Failed
    by _vmName 
| sort desc Failed
| limit 15

| view graph type = column subtype = grouped xaxis = _vmName yaxis = Warning,Failed seriescolor("Warning","#FF8F2E") seriescolor("Failed","#D10000")

widgets_data.title: Finished Restore Sessions by Type
widgets_data.description: Latest finished restore sessions by type.

data.phrase:
dataset in (veeam_*) 
| filter _vendor="Veeam"
| alter 
    _instanceId=arrayindex(regextract(_raw_log, "instanceId\=(\d+)\s"), 0)
| alter 
    _time= parse_timestamp("%FT%H:%M:%E6S%Ez", arrayindex(regextract(_raw_log, "<\d+>1\s+(\S+)\s"), 0)),
    _jobResultCode=arrayindex(if(
        _instanceId in ("790","652"), regextract(_raw_log, "(?:JobResult|param3)\=\"(\d+)\""), 
        _instanceId in ("36022","36026","290","40290"), regextract(_raw_log, "Result\=\"(\d+)\""), 
        _instanceId in ("150","151","451","450"), regextract(_raw_log, "Status\=\"(\d+)\""), 
        _instanceId in ("44102"), regextract(_raw_log, "Status\=\"(\w+)\""), 
        regextract(_raw_log, "JobResult\=\"(\d+)\"")), 0),
    _jobTypeCode=if(_instanceId="40800", "40800", _instanceId="44102", "44102",
        _instanceId in ("290","40290"), "290", arrayindex(if(
            _instanceId in ("790","652"), regextract(_raw_log, "(?:JobType|param4)\=\"(\d+)\""), 
            "1"="1", regextract(_raw_log, "JobType\=\"(\d+)\"")), 0)),
    _host=regextract(_raw_log , "\s(\S+)\s(?:Veeam_MP|Veeam_Backup|Veeam_Security)"),
    _description=arrayindex(regextract(_raw_log, "Description\=\"([^\"]*)(?:\"|$)"),0),
     _day=date_floor(_time ,"d")
| alter _jobResultCode=if(_instanceId in ("150","151","451","450") and _jobResultCode = "3", "1", _instanceId in ("150","151","451","450") and _jobResultCode = "5", "3", _jobResultCode)
| filter _host in ($hosts)
| filter _jobTypeCode  in ("290", "40800", "44102")
| alter 
    _jobResult=if(
        _jobResultCode in ("0", "Success"), "Success",
        _jobResultCode in ("1", "Warning"), "Warning",
        _jobResultCode in ("2", "Failed"), "Failed",
        _jobResultCode = "3", "Working"),
    _jobType=if(
        _jobTypeCode = "290","Restore Session",
        _jobTypeCode = "40800","Configuration Restore",
        _jobTypeCode = "44102","Remote Bare Metal Recovery")
| sort asc _day
| comp 
        count(if(_jobTypeCode in ("290"), 1)) as _restoreJob,
        count(if(_jobTypeCode in ("40800"), 1)) as _configurationRestoreSesionFinished,
        count(if(_jobTypeCode in ("44102"), 1)) as _remoteBmrRestore        
            by _day

| view graph type = column subtype = stacked xaxis = _day yaxis = _restoreJob,_configurationRestoreSesionFinished,_remoteBmrRestore seriestitle("_restoreJob","Restore Session") seriestitle("_configurationRestoreSesionFinished","Configuration Restore") seriestitle("_remoteBmrRestore","Remote Bare Metal Recovery")
